about.en: Cobak Token (CBK) is the utility token of Cobak, a South Korean app-based crypto community and information platform. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0xD85a6Ae55a7f33B0ee113C234d2EE308EdeAF7fD, with a Polygon PoS bridged deployment, and is used for in-app payments, membership benefits and community rewards.
